feedback: Iteration 0 is the only race so far. All 60 trials ended off track (oval 20/20, s-bend 20/20, slalom 20/20), with progress 0.23, 0.11 and 0.07, and 2.0 line-loss events per run. Max error was 0.063 to 0.067 m, just over the 0.06 m limit, so the robot leaves the tape through line loss followed by drift. The candidate changes the fields that address that: base_speed 1.6 to 1.3 (the line-loss rule), sensor spacing widened from 10 mm to 15 mm (x = -0.03 to 0.03), kp 4.0 to 5.0, and kd 0.3 to 0.5. All values are inside the contract ranges, the signal stays bounded by 1 with weights (-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), and the line_loss and observation fields are valid. Nothing is obviously broken, and the change is the directly diagnosed fix, so it is worth racing now to get per-step telemetry. This is early exploration with 10 iterations left. Next race, read the results as follows. If line_loss_events is still above 0 with max_error near 0.05 m, widen the spread further or keep base_speed at 1.3. If line_loss_events is 0 but the robot still runs off track, raise kp toward 6.0, since the correction is too weak. If it finishes but completion_time is above 3 s, raise base_speed toward 1.5 once line loss is zero. If steering_oscillation rises sharply with the higher kp, keep kd at 0.5 or raise it to about 0.7.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is still above 0 with max_error near 0.05 m: keep base_speed at 1.3 and widen sensor x to about ±0.04, because iteration 0 showed line loss of 2.0 per run at base_speed 1.6 with 10 mm spacing.
If line_loss_events is 0 but the robot still leaves the track: raise controller.kp from 5.0 to about 6.0, because the iteration 0 failures came from drift past the 0.06 m limit.
If the robot finishes but completion_time is above 3 s: raise controller.base_speed toward 1.5 once line_loss_events is zero, since the course needs about 1.5 m/s average to finish in 3 s.
